[SWS_DM_01257] ResourceTemporarilyNotAvailable NRC handling
⌈
If
the DM is processing a diagnostic service using a ara::diag interface, that requires
the offer(), and if this interface is not offered yet or not offered any more, the DM shall
return an NRC 0x94 (ResourceTemporarilyNotAvailable).
⌋

[SWS_DM_01257] ResourceTemporarilyNotAvailable NRC handling
⌈
If
the DM is processing a diagnostic service using a ara::diag interface different than
ara::diag::ServiceValidation, that requires the offer(), and if this interface is
not offered yet or not offered any more, the DM shall return an NRC 0x94 (ResourceTem-
porarilyNotAvailable).
⌋
